name: test_from_parts

def test_from_parts():
    mt = hl.MatrixTable.from_parts(globals=TestData.globals, rows=TestData.rows, cols=TestData.cols, entries=TestData.entries)
    TestData.assert_matches_globals(mt)
    TestData.assert_matches_rows(mt)
    TestData.assert_matches_cols(mt)
    TestData.assert_matches_entries(mt)
